scope: Single and all-dataset refresh CLI failure reporting

behavior.all_datasets: Outer failures omit exception contents and dataset names while the batch continues and closes its connection.
behavior.single_dataset: Outer failures print and raise a bounded summary and always close the connection.
behavior.reader_failure: Existing safe reporting-query error classification and metadata behavior remain intact.

coverage: all-dataset failure omits database details and dataset labels
single-dataset failure omits raw exception details
single and all modes close the application connection
existing restricted reporting reader and disabled-feature boundaries remain covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake connections and refresh functions

limitations: No saved dataset query or database service was used.
This does not establish parity for operator-edited dashboard SQL.
